what: Wave 13: OpenAL shim stream-starvation mechanism and queue-depth fix. Deterministic part: scripts/native-audio-render-test.py renders synthetic tones through the shim on OpenAL Soft's wave backend (real mixer clock, file output) and judges the shim's opt-in OPENAL_AUDIO_DIAG counters plus the rendered PCM (scripts/audio-pcm-discontinuity.py); the `stall` case replays the service-thread scheduling stall measured in the game with OPENAL_AUDIO_DIAG_STALL fault injection. Live part: lavapipe skirmish soak of the strict-link binary on a PulseAudio null sink with a real clock. Apple Silicon: UNMEASURED for every number here.
platform: Linux x86-64, Ubuntu 22.04, clang++-14, OpenAL Soft 1.19.1 (wave backend for the deterministic renders, pulse backend on a null sink for the live soak), lavapipe

mechanism.name: stream refill starvation: the service thread that refills the music/stream queue on a 10 ms poll was not scheduled for over a second during map load, the 4 x 8192-frame queue (0.74 s at 44.1 kHz) drained, the source fell to AL_STOPPED and was force-restarted
mechanism.evidence_class: real-time device counters (shim), Linux; confirmed deterministically with fault injection on rendered PCM

lock_contention_not_the_cause.note: post-fix live run maxima; milliseconds against a 0.74-1.49 s queue

mechanism.note: one starvation event in ~10 min is an intermittent pop; a constant crackle on the Mac is explained by this mechanism only if the Mac counters show it firing continuously

fix: StreamVoice::BUFFER_COUNT 4 -> 8 (1.49 s of queue at 44.1 kHz); service thread asks for elevated scheduling (QoS USER_INTERACTIVE on macOS, SCHED_RR on Linux, best effort, refused without privilege and logged); ALC_FREQUENCY=44100 requested explicitly and read back

deterministic_red_green.injected_stall: OPENAL_AUDIO_DIAG_STALL=1000:1200 (1.2 s stall of the service thread at t=1 s, the stall class the live soak measured)

retail_data_renders_wave_backend.menu_music_USA_11_mp3_45s: sample-identical to an ffmpeg decode of the same file (both report the same 9 source-material jumps at a 0.3 threshold; 0 extra)

post_fix_live_soak.how: strict-link zh, lavapipe, OpenAL Soft pulse backend on a PulseAudio null sink (s16le 2ch 44100), OPENAL_AUDIO_DIAG on, skirmish entered from the menu
post_fix_live_soak.map_load_stall_observed: service thread: 1128 ms between passes at t=92 s
post_fix_live_soak.headroom_note: queued_min=1 of 8 after a 1.13 s stall: the fix covers the measured stall with one buffer (186 ms) to spare, not by an order of magnitude

callback_regression_pr153.deterministic: scripts/native-audio-callback-test.py on this slice: pass (all completions on the API thread inside an AIL_* call, 0 idle deliveries, defect observed false)
callback_regression_pr153.live_soak: UNMEASURED for this slice: the lavapipe skirmish in this session ended in an instant victory screen with no starting units, so no 10-minute callback soak ran; the Wave 12 numbers in audio-callback-soak.json are the last live measurement
